lines.lat: što si došol vo našava zemja,
lines.en: why did you come into our land,

lines.cyr: што си дошол во нашава земја?
lines.lat: što si došol vo našava zemja?
lines.en: why did you come into our land?

lines.cyr: Ал' си дошол, ал си дошол,
lines.lat: Al' si došol, al si došol,
lines.en: Did you come, did you come

lines.cyr: ал' си дошол вино да пиеме,
lines.lat: al' si došol vino da pieme,
lines.en: did you come to drink wine with us,

lines.cyr: ал' си дошол камен да фрламе?
lines.lat: al' si došol kamen da frlame?
lines.en: did you come to join us in stone throwing games?

lines.cyr: - А бре вие, а бре вие,
lines.lat: - A bre vie, a bre vie,

lines.cyr: не сум дошол оро да играме,
lines.lat: ne sum došol oro da igrame,
lines.en: I did not come to dance with you,

lines.cyr: не сум дошол оро да играме.
lines.lat: ne sum došol oro da igrame.
lines.en: I did not come to dance with you.

lines.cyr: Не сум дошол, не сум дошол,
lines.lat: Ne sum došol, ne sum došol,
lines.en: I didn’t come, I didn’t come,

lines.cyr: не сум дошол камен да фрламе,
lines.lat: ne sum došol kamen da frlame,
lines.en: I did not come for the stone throwing games,

lines.cyr: тук' сум дошол по ваша другарчка.
lines.lat: tuk' sum došol po vaša drugarčka.
lines.en: rather I came here for your friend.
